summary.text: Lara Westdorp is the Democratic candidate for Maryland State Senate District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent William Folden (R) is also running.
A healthcare professional, she advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Westdorp earned a bachelor's degree from The Ohio State University in 1990 and a graduate degree from the Indiana University School of Public and Environmental Affairs in 1992.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a small business owner and mother whose public service career ranged from local and state boards and commissions to the Maryland General Assembly, Congress and the White House.

Westdorp said in the survey that she is running for elected office for the first time and listed support for lowering the cost of essentials, a livable wage, term limits for elected officials, labor unions, and control on data center development.
She also listed opposition to unlawful actions by ICE and 287(g) programs, to raising property, income or sales taxes for everyday residents, and to new power lines.
